framework.primary_law: Act on the Development of Artificial Intelligence and Establishment of Trust (AI Basic Act)
framework.max_penalty: Administrative fines up to KRW 30 million (about US$21,000); corrective orders including service suspension
framework.geographic_scope: Applies to AI developers and AI-using businesses, including foreign firms affecting Korean users or markets; foreign firms above revenue or user thresholds must appoint a local representative.

research.summary: South Korea's AI Basic Act took effect on 22 January 2026, making it the second comprehensive national AI law after the EU's. It sets duties for high-impact AI (health, energy, transport, hiring, biometrics), labelling for generative AI, extra safety duties for very large models (10^26 FLOPs per an MSIT notice), and extraterritorial reach. Penalties are modest and a one-year fine grace period has been signalled.

risk_tiers.description: Systems that significantly affect life, safety or fundamental rights: impact assessment, explainability, user protection plan, human oversight, documentation.
Models trained at or above 10^26 cumulative FLOPs: risk management and reporting to MSIT.
Labelling of AI output; clear notice for realistic synthetic sound, image or video.

key_provisions.title: High-impact AI duties
key_provisions.description: Operators must assess whether their system is high-impact and meet explainability, oversight and documentation duties.

key_provisions.title: Generative AI labelling
key_provisions.description: Output must be labelled as AI-generated; realistic synthetic media needs clear notice.

key_provisions.title: Local representative
key_provisions.description: Foreign operators above revenue or user thresholds must appoint a domestic agent.

cross_jurisdiction_tensions.tension: Both regulate high-risk uses and labelling, but Korea's fines are far lower and definitions differ, so firms need separate classification work.

safety_risk_management.rationale: Defined high-impact category and safety duties for the largest models; details await decrees.

privacy_data_protection.rationale: Relies largely on existing personal data law; AI-specific data duties limited.

human_oversight.rationale: Human oversight is an explicit duty for high-impact AI.

transparency.rationale: Generative AI labelling and user notice are mandated.

accountability.rationale: MSIT can order corrections; penalties are small.

fairness_non_discrimination.rationale: Fundamental-rights impact assessment is an effort duty, not a firm obligation.

environmental_sustainability.rationale: No AI-specific environmental provisions identified in the sources.

access_to_remedy.rationale: Corrective orders exist, but individual redress routes were not described.

gaps_and_weaknesses: Enforcement decrees and the fine grace period leave real obligations unclear.
Fundamental-rights impact assessment is only an effort duty.
research.monitor_notes: Enforcement decree details and the one-year grace period on fines should be checked against MSIT publications. Scores are provisional AI-drafted judgements against the AIETHOS rubric and reflect protections currently in force.

citizen.one_line: South Korea now has a binding AI law that makes companies label AI content and take extra care when AI affects your health, job or rights.
citizen.what_changed: Since 22 January 2026, businesses using AI in areas like hiring, healthcare or energy must assess the risk, explain how their AI works and keep a human in the loop. Generative AI content must be labelled.
citizen.who_is_protected: People in Korea affected by AI products and services, including those offered by foreign companies.
who_is_not_protected: People affected by AI used for national security
People harmed during the early grace period, when fines are not expected to be imposed

your_rights.what_it_means: Companies must tell you when a product or service uses AI and label AI-generated content.
your_rights.how_to_invoke: Ask the provider where AI is used; complain to MSIT if no notice is given.

your_rights.what_it_means: If AI significantly affects you (for example in hiring), the operator must be able to explain it.
your_rights.how_to_invoke: Ask the operator in writing for an explanation of how the AI reached the outcome.

citizen.plain_language_summary: Korea's law asks companies to be open about AI and to be careful when it affects your life. Penalties are small for now.

jargon_buster.High-impact AI: AI that can significantly affect life, safety or fundamental rights.
jargon_buster.FLOPs: A measure of the computing used to train an AI model.
